description.label: Description
description.value:
You suddenly become less accomplished at math as your foe cuts half your hand off. If you still have both feet you can count to ten on your toes instead.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). You also lose 1d10/2 fingers – @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.SYjWiKDzMS6CtROJ]{Amputation (Challenging)}. If five fingers are lost you lose the entire hand.
